name: Sitcom: Location Exterior
description: Image preset for a location exterior in the Sitcom look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an exterior establishing shot. Name the location's defining structure, surroundings, time of day, and weather from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: wide exterior establishing view of the location, clear foreground, midground and background, a sense of scale from a figure or doorway, multi-camera sitcom still, bright even studio lighting, three-wall standing set dressed with lived-in detail, medium shot at eye level, high-key lighting with soft shadows, warm saturated colour, everything in focus
negative_prompt: dark moody lighting, cinematic shallow focus, horror, gritty grain, text, watermark
